text:
Samira: Quick question — an enterprise customer is asking us to purge a subset of request logs (debug traces + access logs) from last week. Who can actually trigger an ephemeral prune? Is this a self-serve SRE action or do we need Security/Legal approval?

Navin: Short answer: not self-serve. We require a formal data-erase request in JIRA plus approvals from Security and Data Privacy. We also need confirmation that those logs aren’t captured in any nightly snapshots/backups. See internal playbook: https://redwood.internal/docs/data-erase and follow the checklist there.

Samira: Understood. They’re pushing for today — if I open the ticket and tag @leo (privacy) and @maria (SRE), can we fast-track?

Maria: We can run a one-off prune but SRE needs a ticket with exact scope and the `data-delete` RBAC role must be assigned to the operator. Please include: customer ID, exact time range, log paths (e.g., s3://redwood-prod/request-logs/YYYY/MM/DD/...), and whether traces include full user payloads or just IDs. We'll run it via the ops job below after approvals.

Maria: Example dry-run command (share in the ticket):
```
./ops/prune_logs --env prod --customer=ACME_CORP --from=2026-03-10 --to=2026-03-12 --dry-run
```

Navin: Also note: if any PII is present we need Legal signoff. Attach an export sample (redacted) to the ticket so Privacy can confirm. Once approved, Security will create the retention exception record and we’ll add an audit entry.

Leo: If it’s only debug + no PII, I can review quickly. Tag me in the Jira and include the sample rows.

Samira: Creating the ticket now and adding the snippet + sample logs. Will tag @navin @leo @maria. Link: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/DATA-4321 (created, please check).

jira-bot: Ticket DATA-4321 created by samira and assigned to security and privacy reviewers. Attachments: prune-dryrun.txt.

audit-bot: Reminder: any deletion must write an entry to /audit/deletes with job id, operator, and justification. This is required for compliance.

Maria: Once the ticket has approvals and the audit entry is prepared, I’ll schedule the prune during a low-traffic window (ETA ~2 hours after approvals). Will post the job id here.

Samira: Awesome — doing that now. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
